## Interactions

Behaviour that is not a property of this part alone. Each interaction names the records it spans, the conditions it holds under, and how far it has been confirmed. ### int-usb-type-c-009-cc-stusb4500

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-usb-type-c-009-cc-stusb4500" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-usb-type-c-009-c456012` (this record)
- **Conditions:** Post-fix board-a topology routes J1.A5/J1.B5 directly to STUSB4500 U1.2/U1.4 with 0-ohm R19/R20 jumpers into the debounce nets, DNP R17/R18 Rd provisions (STUSB4500 presents its internal Rd) and DNP D6/D7 ESD provisions; PD negotiation requires intact CC continuity through the receptacle — continuity-map both CC pads with no cable and both plug orientations on the dead v4 boards before any board-a order
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-usb-type-c-009-cc-pins`](#fact-usb-type-c-009-cc-pins)
- [`fact-usb-type-c-009-cc-topology`](#fact-usb-type-c-009-cc-topology)
- [`fact-usb-type-c-009-pad-set`](#fact-usb-type-c-009-pad-set)

### int-usb-type-c-009-vbus-in

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-usb-type-c-009-vbus-in" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-usb-type-c-009-c456012` (this record)
- **Conditions:** J1.A9/J1.B9 feed VBUS\_IN shared with U1 VBUS sense/discharge, C1 10 uF and C2 100 nF decoupling, D5 SMAJ20A 20 V-standoff TVS, R14 470-ohm discharge path, Q1 load-switch input and R11 VBEN divider; the negotiated 15 V / 3 A contract exceeds the mirror-stated 5 V rating and uses the full 3 A rating — verify thermal and contact behavior at 15 V on the bench
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-usb-type-c-009-rating-voltage`](#fact-usb-type-c-009-rating-voltage)
- [`fact-usb-type-c-009-rating-current`](#fact-usb-type-c-009-rating-current)

## Legend

What the recorded terms on this page mean, in ordinary words. The exact terms above are the ones that count; these descriptions explain them and never replace them.

### Verdict

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NEEDS BENCH` | Cannot be settled from documents. It needs measurement on real hardware before it can be relied on. |
| `UNSOURCED`   | No accepted source backs this value yet. Treat it as a claim, not a fact.                           |

### Provenance

| Recorded term    | What it means                                          |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `PROJECT-CHOICE` | A decision made by this project. No vendor asserts it. |
| `UNVERIFIED`     | Recorded, but not yet backed by an accepted source.    |

### Fact class

| Recorded term           | What it means                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ABSOLUTE_MAXIMUM`      | A never-exceed limit. Reaching it may damage the part; it is not an operating target and there is no margin implied by it.                                         |
| `GUARANTEED_ELECTRICAL` | A parameter the manufacturer guarantees over the stated conditions, usually with minimum, typical and maximum values.                                              |
| `PROJECT_STATE`         | A value this project recorded about how the part is used here — a chosen operating point, a net assignment, or a derived figure. Not a manufacturer specification. |
| `RECOMMENDED_OPERATION` | The range the manufacturer intends the part to be used in. Always narrower than the absolute maximum.                                                              |

### Coverage status

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OPEN`        | Unresolved. Open means the question has not been answered, not that the part is unsafe — the reason states what is missing. |

### Source availability

| Recorded term        | What it means                                                                                                         |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AVAILABLE`          | The document was retrieved and is on record.                                                                          |
| `SOURCE UNAVAILABLE` | The document could not be retrieved. It stays listed so the gap is visible; anything resting on it remains unsourced. |

### Source authority

| Recorded term          | What it means                                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DISTRIBUTOR_IDENTITY` | A distributor listing. Establishes which part this is, nothing more.                                     |
| `MANUFACTURER_MIRROR`  | A copy of a manufacturer document hosted elsewhere. Usable, but weaker than the manufacturer's own copy. |
| `MANUFACTURER_PRIMARY` | The manufacturer's own document for this exact part.                                                     |
| `PROJECT_GENERATOR`    | A document this project generated, such as a schematic or netlist export.                                |

### Identity state

| Recorded term | What it means                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VERIFIED`    | The exact orderable part has been confirmed against a source. |

### Source state

| Recorded term | What it means                                          |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `AVAILABLE`   | At least one document backing this line was retrieved. |

### Unit

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                      |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NONE`        | The value is not a physical quantity, so it carries no unit. Recorded as \`NONE\`. |
